Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand the highest-value workloads and the latency/cost targets you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Summary: you’re focusing on low-latency inference for document summarization and conversational search (internal teams + B2B customers). Primary constraints: sub-200ms p95 for short prompts, strict data isolation for customer PII, and predictable monthly throughput for pricing.
- Goal for next meeting: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra engineers to walk your stack, validate model choices, and agree on a mutual action plan (MVP config + perf targets).

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2026-09-15, 10:00–11:30
- Fri 2026-09-18, 10:00–11:30
- Mon 2026-09-21, 14:00–15:30 (for APAC-friendly alternative)

Draft agenda (60–90m):
1) 10 min: context & success metrics (EdgeWave)
2) 25–35 min: infra & model fit — Redwood team deep-dive (serving runtime, routing, caching)
3) 15–20 min: security/compliance and data residency discussion
4) 15–25 min: live Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

I’ve attached a short prep readout with discovery notes and a suggested attendee list (attachment: edgewave-tdx-readout.pdf). If you already know who from your side should join (security/infra/product), send names and I’ll loop in the relevant Redwood folks.

If the Friday slot works, I can lock that and invite our infra lead Karthik and solutions engineer Marissa.

Thanks — Rishi

- Can you confirm whether Redwood can pin model versions to a dedicated pool (for regulatory reasons) and what the SLA looks like?

We’ll have product (me), infra (Tom), and security (Priya) on the call. If you want us to share any environment details beforehand (e.g., request volume snapshots), let us know and I’ll have Tom drop them in the Drive link.
